minutes.headline: Building committee interviewed three architect finalists for the old Passios school reuse; selection deferred to a Feb 5 meeting.
minutes.summary: The committee interviewed three architecture teams for the study and design of reusing the old Passios school as town offices, school administration and community space. Each presented and answered the same questions on hazardous materials, cost control, schedule, security and traffic. Afterward the committee penciled in meetings for Feb 5, 12 and 26 and agreed the chair and the town manager's office would coordinate reference checks. No selection was made.

budget_items.what_was_said: Johnson Roberts said its projects bid below estimate on average and change orders stay low.
Johnson Roberts cited a combined public safety building in a small town that won design and construction funding at town meeting.
The second firm said its estimates land close to bids and it holds guaranteed maximum price contracts through its construction arm.
The second firm said only the civil/landscape subconsultant would take a small share of the contract.
Johnson Roberts estimated a quarter of the work would go to consultants.
Abacus estimated the split between architecture and consultants and said a land survey could be paid from the study funds set aside.
Abacus raised whether the project would be funded via the capital plan, debt exclusion or override.
Abacus described billing only a portion of a six-figure study fee because work was paced to town politics.
Abacus referred to an earlier plan's renovation cost and said its approach would cost more but give better value.
figures_as_heard: nine and a half million dollars

decisions.decision: Meetings set for Wednesday Feb 5 at 6 p.m., Feb 12 and Feb 26; Feb 19 skipped for the holiday week.

Members to bring their scoring rubric numbers to the next meeting to build a composite evaluation.

what_happened.line: The committee made no selection; it interviewed three architect finalists for reusing the old Passios school and deferred the choice to a later meeting.
Meetings were set for Wednesday Feb 5 at 6 p.m., Feb 12 and Feb 26, with Feb 19 skipped for the holiday week.
The chair will coordinate reference checks with the town manager's office, and results will be shared as scores rather than in minutes.
Members were asked to bring their scoring rubric numbers to the next meeting so a composite evaluation can be built.
Johnson Roberts, the second firm and Abacus each answered questions on cost control, and Abacus raised how the project might be funded.

why_it_matters: The firm chosen will design the reuse of the old Passios school as town offices, school administration and community space, which sets the scope and cost of a project that may later reach residents as a funding vote.
Abacus raised whether the project would be funded through the capital plan, a debt exclusion or an override; a debt exclusion or override would appear on a tax bill and need a ballot vote.
